summary.text: Jan Jones was first elected to office in 2003 and represents Georgia House District 47 in northwest Fulton County; the legislature biography says she was elected Speaker Pro Tempore in 2010 and in each term thereafter.

paragraphs.text: Jones was born in Warner Robins and holds a B.A. from the University of Georgia and an M.B.A. in finance from Georgia State University.
Jones worked in marketing and finance and as a small business owner before holding office.
